user_summary_md:
## Your Situation

You are an experienced investor with a multi-asset portfolio (equities, bonds, ETFs, alternatives). You are looking for a stress test and tactical rebalancing review. Your 10+ year horizon gives you time to absorb short-term volatility.
portfolio_diagnosis_md: Portfolio allocation: ~70% equity, 20% bonds, 10% alternatives. Overlap detected between large-cap ETF positions and individual stock names. Cost drag is moderate — some positions carry higher-than-necessary expense ratios. Stress test (2022 inflation scenario): estimated -18% drawdown from current levels.

options.title: Reduce Overlap and Consolidate
options.best_for: Investors who want a cleaner, lower-cost portfolio
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
Consolidate overlapping large-cap positions into a single index fund.

### Why this works
Reduces hidden duplication, lowers cost drag, simplifies rebalancing.

### Pros
- Lower cost
- Cleaner portfolio

### Cons
- May trigger capital gains on switches

### Agent guidance
Start by identifying your highest-overlap fund pairs using fund_overlap_analyzer.

options.title: Tactical Macro Tilt
options.best_for: Active investors comfortable with tactical position adjustments
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
Shift 10% from bonds to inflation-hedged assets (TIPS, commodities) given current macro.

### Why this works
In a sticky-inflation environment, TIPS and commodities historically outperform nominal bonds.

### Pros
- Better inflation protection
- Active risk management

### Cons
- Higher trading activity, more tax complexity

### Agent guidance
Monitor CPI trend monthly. Reverse tilt when inflation falls below 2.5%.

options.title: Stress-Based Rebalance
options.best_for: Investors who want to use the stress test results to drive allocation
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
Rebalance to reduce allocation to sectors with highest stress-test drawdown.

### Why this works
Reduces worst-case drawdown by trimming over-exposed sectors revealed by the stress test.

### Pros
- Data-driven decision
- Improves risk/return profile

### Cons
- Requires accepting some gains realisation

### Agent guidance
Focus on trimming sectors with >-40% stress drawdown first.

hidden_disclosures: Large-cap ETF overlap with individual stocks means you effectively hold some names at 2x weight.
Active fund expense ratios in your portfolio: check each fund factsheet — averages are typically 0.5-1.5%/yr.
Tactical tilt transactions may trigger STCG if positions held <12 months.
Alternatives (if illiquid) may have redemption gates or lock-up periods — check offering documents.
